goals.text: A connected repository goes from a new issue to an announced release with no human step but the maintainer's decisions
Agents' work holds a quality bar the maintainer can trust without reading every diff
The person who asked for a change hears where it is available at each stage and can confirm it works
The maintainer sees in one place what waits on them, across all their repositories
Agents keep to the written direction: work outside the goals is postponed or declined with its reason
Agents pursue a goal: they propose the work that reaches it, and the maintainer approves it
The loop knows whether each goal is met, from a measure, and proposes changing the direction when it is
